_readme: Display order and grouping for the Made by FRT catalogue (/made-by-frt/). Build input only: tools/ is kept off the public site by .assetsignore. Order here IS the page order. Free items are read from data/originals.json and paid items from tools/payhip-drafts/paid-resources.json (so titles, text, prices and links are never copied here). category is one of interactive-stories, partner-speaking, guides. tags is for temporary labels only (halloween): remove the tag, or move the items down the list, when the season is over. featured gives one card the larger layout.
